review.summary: The memo stays within the authorized research scope and largely distinguishes checked evidence from unresolved gaps. Two minor corrections would improve its consistency and source assessment.

findings.title: Distinguish FCT existence from its legal designation and boundaries
findings.detail: The summary and support table say the FCT has no primary-text support, although the inspected 1996 speech expressly describes a 30-state structure with a Federal Capital Territory. Qualify the unsupported claims as the FCT's creation instrument, designation date, component areas and capital-transfer date. The speech supports its acknowledged existence by 1996.
findings.evidence: The memo's Source 5 correctly quotes the speech's '30-state structure with a Federal Capital Territory'; I independently retrieved that passage from the linked Archivi.ng page on 2026-10-26.
findings.assessment_of_response: First review round; no response yet.

findings.title: Update the UT source assessment with the accessible index
findings.detail: The reported bot-wall result is properly disclosed, but the index is accessible through a direct HTTP request during this review. Record its confirmed listing and attribution rather than leaving those facts entirely unverified. Inspecting the actual map and establishing item-specific reuse rights remain separate checks.
findings.evidence: Retrieved https://maps.lib.utexas.edu/maps/nigeria.html on 2026-10-26 with HTTP 200. It lists 'Nigeria (Political) 1993' with image and PDF links and states that maps were produced by the US Central Intelligence Agency unless otherwise indicated.
findings.assessment_of_response: First review round; no response yet.
